title: Capital Flows — X Money · Digital Credit ↔ Margin ↔ JR-strcUSX
notes: v43: same Lyft / GrubHub card; Lyft → Digital Credit, GrubHub → X Money (owner 2026-08-29). v42: GrubHub added to the Lyft card. v41: Lyft → Digital Credit only (no Lyft → X Money). v40: JR-strcUSX card at the bottom of Liquidity Engine, bidirectional with Margin. Spine: X Money → Digital Credit → Margin. Turo → X Money only. X Money still funds Deploy and still two-way with Digital Credit (cash ↔ Morpho/BTC).

legend.observed: Seen in YNAB/Plaid or expense sheet

income_sources.label: Turo
income_sources.evidence: Turo payouts land X Money (ops cash sleeve).

income_sources.label: Lyft / GrubHub
income_sources.evidence: Lyft lands Digital Credit (Coinbase/Morpho). GrubHub lands X Money (ops cash). Same income card; two landings.

income_sources.label: ASICs
income_sources.evidence: Braiins → Digital Credit (Coinbase) every other month.

channels.label: X Money
channels.subtitle: ~6% · ops float
channels.notes: Ops cash sleeve (left of LE). Receives Turo + GrubHub; funds Deploy; two-way with Digital Credit (cash ↔ Morpho/BTC).

channels.label: Digital Credit
channels.subtitle: BTC · Morpho · HY
channels.notes: Morpho engine mid-LE: liquidity → BTC spot; LTV cool → HY LTV Buffer; LTV hot → HY tops BTC. One Card refinance via Morpho. Two-way with X Money and with Margin. HY is generic high-yield defense (venue product incidental).

channels.label: Margin
channels.subtitle: Agentic · stocks · HY
channels.notes: RH equities engine: liquidity → stock spot; margin cool → HY LTV Buffer; heat → HY tops stock. Bidirectional with Digital Credit (not X Money) and with JR-strcUSX. Optional extract is not income. HY is generic high-yield defense (venue product incidental).

channels.label: JR-strcUSX
channels.subtitle: DC-credit parlay
channels.notes: Bottom of LE. Bidirectional with Margin only. DC-credit parlay (Solana sleeve) — not HY / not LTV defense. Visibility of the live book; now-deploy lock stands (no mint).

channels.label: Collateral
channels.subtitle: Agentic · BTC stack
channels.notes: Deploy sink for free dollars into investable collateral (Agentic / BTC) after Essential + Fleet, before discretionary.

edges.notes: GrubHub lands X Money (ops cash). Not Digital Credit.

edges.label: cash → DC engine
edges.notes: X Money funds Digital Credit (Coinbase / Morpho / BTC / HY LTV Buffer).

edges.label: borrow → cash
edges.notes: Morpho USDC (and ops surplus) into X Money cash sleeve.

edges.label: invest collateral
edges.notes: Free dollars into Agentic / BTC collateral after ops floors.

edges.label: → equities engine
edges.notes: Digital Credit funds / rebalances into Margin (RH Agentic · stocks · USDG). Replaces prior X Money → Margin auto as the DC–Margin spine.

edges.label: optional extract
edges.notes: Optional loop back Digital Credit ← Margin — NOT income. Dual-engine risk.

edges.label: → JR-strcUSX
edges.notes: Margin seats / rebalances into JR-strcUSX. Same two-way LE spine as Digital Credit ↔ Margin. Visibility path — not a mint.

edges.label: → Margin
edges.notes: JR-strcUSX back into the Margin equities engine. Same two-way LE spine as the cards above.
